item.title: FCC clears SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million Starmind satellites for orbital AI data centers by 2040
item.description:
【the-decoder.com】The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million Starmind satellites to process AI data as orbital data centers. SpaceX is targeting its first launches in 2027, and the full constellation is set to be operating by 2040. Google and Blue Origin are also working on AI infrastructure in space, but Boston Consulting Group estimates costs will stay well above ground-based data centers for now. item.title: Microsoft details how state-backed hackers use the ARTEX AI framework to automate cyberattacks
item.description:
【the-decoder.com】Microsoft has published the technical architecture of ARTEX, an AI framework in wide use since July 2026 that runs cyberattacks with specialized agents and almost no human involvement. State-backed groups from China and North Korea, along with criminal organizations, are already using the system. Microsoft recommends deception techniques like honeypots and faked success signals as defenses, but how long those will hold up against agents that learn and adapt remains an open question. The article Microsoft details how state-backed hackers use the ARTEX AI framework to automate cyberattacks appeared first on The Decoder.
